title: This Owl Hears a Vole Under Two Feet of Snow, Then Dives In

scenes.text: This owl can hear a mouse hiding under two feet of snow.
Snow muffles almost every sound, but not the low rumble of digging.
The great gray owl's huge round face funnels that sound into its ears.
Snow bends sound, so the owl hovers to find the exact spot.
Then it drops, and punches through the snow with its talons.
It hears through two feet of snow. You can barely hear through a wall.

description:
The great gray owl can find voles beneath nearly two feet of snow, according to a University of California Riverside study.
Its huge facial disc funnels sound and it hovers to cancel the bending effect of snow, then plunges in.
Could you pick out a whisper through a wall of snow?
first_comment: Bonus: the owl's wings are built to fly almost silently, which helps it hear prey better. Which animal has the best hearing, do you think?
